name: @guardbee/mcp-ai-code-scanner
description: MCP server that scans code for insecure LLM/AI integration patterns — client-exposed API keys, unsafe handling of model output, excessive agent tool permissions, and PII sent to third-party LLMs
long_description: Scans text, single files, or entire directories for insecure AI/LLM integration patterns: API keys bundled into client-side code, model output executed via eval()/exec() or rendered as raw HTML, agent tools that grant unchecked shell/code execution, personal data (email, national ID, card numbers) interpolated directly into prompts, and untrusted input mixed into system prompts. No API key required — runs entirely locally.
